title: 3 SPEED AUTO. TRANS.-OIL COOLER PIPES
summary: Automatic transmission (RPO M40) oil cooler lines: steel inlet and outlet pipes run from the transmission case fittings forward along the right side of the engine, past the starter and oil pan, to the radiator's built-in cooler. At the radiator, short pipes from the radiator tank fittings connect to the long lines with rubber hoses and hose clamps. The two lines are tied together by snap clips along the way and held by one clip screwed down near the front lower control arm. 454 engines use different hoses and inlet pipe.
